summary_en: 140,000 shares (0.34% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-26 at ¥375/share (closing price 2026-08-25), ¥52.5M upper limit. Execution window: single transaction at 08:45 JST, non-extensible to other trading venues or times.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-exchange transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-25, TRADE WORKS Co., Ltd resolved by board decision to acquire up to 140,000 treasury shares (0.34% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) for ¥52.5M via ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange transaction. The purchase will execute on 2026-08-26 at 08:45 JST at the closing price of ¥375/share from 2026-08-25 (final special quotation inclusive). The order is time-limited to that single trading window with no option to extend to other trading venues or times. The company states the acquisition supports shareholder returns, equity compensation programs for officers and employees, and flexible capital policy execution, balanced against growth investment funding and financial soundness. Results will be announced after market close on 2026-08-26.
